title: RBAC v1 → v2 migration plan implementation (dual-eval, metrics, rollout, deprecation)
creator: Connor O'Brien
description:
Goal
Implement the RBAC v1 → v2 migration plan across Hosted/Dedicated/Private with a safe rollout strategy:
- Dual-evaluation (v1 enforced, v2 shadow) and then v2 enforcement.
- End-to-end observability: metrics + dashboards + alerting for authz decision deltas.
- Rollout playbook and rollback procedure that SRE/Support can execute.
- Deprecation timeline + removal criteria for v1 checks and compatibility code.

Context
RBAC v1 is currently a mix of feature gates + ad-hoc checks that are inconsistent across control plane + console. RBAC v2 introduces resource/action/scope and a centralized evaluation path. The migration must avoid breaking enterprise admin workflows (billing/security/SSO/dedicated ops) and must generate audit evidence for allow/deny decisions.

Non-goals
- No refactor of IdP integrations beyond what’s required for role resolution.
- No changes to data-plane inference authorization beyond existing tenant/project scoping.

Implementation plan
1) Dual-evaluation plumbing (control plane + console backend)
- Add feature flag support for:
  - authz.v2.shadow (evaluate v2, do not enforce; log/emit metrics)
  - authz.v2.enforce (enforce v2 decision)
  - authz.v2.fail_open (emergency: if policy eval errors, allow but emit metric + log)
- Ensure request context includes actor_id, org_id, project_id, role_ids, policy_version.
- Standardize reason codes for deny decisions to support dashboards and support playbooks.

2) Metrics + dashboards
Emit the following metrics (tagged by service, route, org_tier, environment, action, decision, reason_code):
- authz_eval_total{engine=v1|v2, decision=allow|deny|error}
- authz_shadow_diff_total{v1=allow|deny, v2=allow|deny} (only in shadow mode)
- authz_eval_latency_ms{engine=v2} (p50/p95/p99)
- authz_policy_cache_hit_ratio (if applicable per service)
- authz_fail_open_total (should be ~0)

Dashboards
- "RBAC v2 Shadow Diffs" (top routes/actions by diff rate, orgs affected)
- "RBAC v2 Evaluation Health" (latency, errors, cache hit rate)
- "RBAC v2 Enforcement" (403 volume by reason code, rate per org)

Alerting (initial)
- Shadow diff rate > 0.5% for any P0/P1 routes over 15m
- authz_eval_error_total > threshold (service-specific)
- authz_fail_open_total > 0 in prod
- Spike in 403s on billing/SSO/autoscaling endpoints after enforcement

3) Rollout stages
Hosted (SaaS)
- Stage 0: dev/staging enforce v2 (with v1 fallback available)
- Stage 1: prod shadow mode for 7 days; triage diffs daily
- Stage 2: prod enforcement for internal orgs + canary customers (by allowlist)
- Stage 3: full enforcement; keep v1 evaluation path available for rollback window

Dedicated
- Same as Hosted but coordinate with Dedicated ops endpoints (autoscaling/GPU pool config). Ensure Billing Admin vs Org Admin separation does not block day-2 ops.

Private
- Policy bundle version skew is expected. Migration gates:
  - Installer must pin a policy bundle version compatible with the release.
  - Shadow mode by default for first GA version, with explicit customer opt-in to enforce.

4) Deprecation timeline & removal criteria
- “v1 compatibility window” begins when v2 enforcement is enabled for 100% of Hosted.
- Removal criteria:
  - Shadow diffs < 0.05% for 14 consecutive days (P0/P1 routes).
  - No open P0/P1 support tickets attributable to RBAC enforcement.
  - Audit log exporter confirmed stable for new fields.
- After criteria met: remove v1 checks endpoint-by-endpoint with rollback PR plan.

Acceptance criteria
- Dual-eval + enforcement feature flags work across control plane + console backend.
- Shadow diff metrics emitted everywhere we evaluate v2; dashboards exist and are linked here.
- Rollout playbook is written (runbook format), including rollback and support escalation.
- Deprecation plan with concrete dates and owners is agreed by Security + SRE + PM.
- Sign-off from Security (Marcus), SRE (Sean), Control Plane (Ethan/Kaitlyn), Console (Chloe).

Links
- Confluence migration plan: sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/rbac-and-auth/rbac-v2-migration-plan.json
- Authz decision logging spec: sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/audit-logging/authz-decision-audit-logging.json
- Related PRs:
  - PR: Dual-evaluation mode + shadow-deny metrics: sources/github/redwood/pr_18579.json
  - PR: Standardized authz error responses + logging fields: sources/github/redwood/pr_18451.json
  - PR: Policy cache + invalidation metrics: sources/github/redwood/pr_18477.json
  - PR: Remove legacy RBAC v1 checks (initial set): sources/github/redwood/pr_18602.json

Open questions
- Do we default to deny-on-error vs fail-open for v2 eval errors in enforcement? Proposal: deny-on-error for Security Admin operations; fail-open only behind emergency flag with paging.
- How do we segment shadow diff metrics by "sensitive" (P0/P1) routes? Proposal: tag actions with sensitivity in policy bundle and emit as metric label.
- Private: do we allow support impersonation in enforced mode? Pending leadership decision + threat model.
comments:
2025-02-03 (Connor O'Brien)
Kicked off implementation with Kaitlyn + Jordan. Plan is to land dual-eval in control plane middleware first, then wire console backend once route inventory is stable. Metrics naming aligned with Allison (logging/trace standards).

2025-02-11 (Kaitlyn Nguyen)
Shadow diff metric implemented in control plane for org + project scoped actions. Need follow-up to include dedicated ops endpoints; they currently bypass middleware in one service (legacy admin router). Filed follow-up task for Benji to route through authz hook.

2025-02-18 (Sean Gallagher)
SRE request: rollback must be executable without deploy if possible (feature flag flip + allowlist). Also need explicit guidance on what to do if 403 spike blocks billing admin during incident. Suggest add “emergency role grant” vs disabling enforcement globally.

2025-02-24 (Marcus Lin)
Security review: approve dual-eval approach but require:
- audit logs include policy_version and role_ids before enforcement is enabled in prod
- deny reason codes must not leak sensitive resource existence (use generic codes for some endpoints)
- add explicit monitoring for support/break-glass usage during rollout

2025-03-02 (Connor O'Brien)
Hosted prod shadow mode started for 10% of orgs (allowlist). Shadow diffs concentrated in billing export + SSO config endpoints. Root cause appears to be role mapping bug for Billing Admin lacking audit-log export permission per updated SoD guidance. Working with policy bundle PR to adjust default role permissions and/or update UI copy.

2025-03-07 (Chloe Martin)
Console backend now emits authz_shadow_diff_total with route tags. Found a couple console-only actions without stable action names; aligning with ENG-5383 taxonomy. Blocking enforcement for console until action naming is finalized (to avoid churn in policy bundle).

2025-03-10 (Connor O'Brien)
Drafted rollout playbook + rollback steps and shared with SRE + Support ops (Dev/ Owen). Next: finalize deprecation dates with Naomi (PM) and confirm Private default (shadow-only first release) with Vivek + Hanae.

2025-03-12 (Connor O'Brien)
Moved to In Review. Remaining items before Done:
- Link dashboards in this ticket once Grafana boards are merged
- Confirm alert thresholds with SRE
- Final sign-off from Marcus + Sean
- Add explicit deprecation timeline section with target date for v1 removal PRs (post 14-day stability window)
